items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was that Willie Joseph... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. He went to California and came out and got killed in a car.

ctx.x: Oh, that's when Alamo with Kaiser. We stayed eight years. That's right.
